store.0: Hypertension: Losartan 50 mg once daily. BP: 135–140/80–90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and low sodium intake instead of increasing dose. Taking daily magnesium supplement for potential BP support.
store.1: Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine 75 mcg daily, taken on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). No dosage changes needed. Notice sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.
store.2: Osteoarthritis: Uses acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Takes meloxicam 7.5 mg only when joints are stiff(e.g., knees, hands), not daily to avoid overuse of NSAIDs. Doctor recommended glucosamine supplements; effect unclear—no definitive improvement reported yet.
store.3: Vitamin D & Bone Health: D3 2000 IU daily(from 22 ng/mL to target >30 ng/mL). Calcium supplements for early osteopenia. K2 recommended for calcium absorption. Also on atorvastatin 10 mg daily. LDL improved from 130 mg/dL. Triglycerides 140 mg/dL initially. No side effects reported.
store.4: Overall Assessment: Medication routine working well. Organized with pill planner and phone reminders. Focuses on lifestyle changes to reduce medication reliance. Goal: Stay healthy, avoid unnecessary prescriptions, manage conditions naturally when possible.
